* '''Original''' (this page, 18 March 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (18 March 2021). Players Committee card image, 18 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V14-L-ouronlyhope-20210318.png]] ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/ouronlyhope.png Holotable commit c241f88 “vset14”], no mark). Text: “Relocate Prophecy Of The Force to a site. OR If He Is The Chosen One or He Will Bring Balance on table, ▲ Yoda's Hut or a Death Star II site.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Our Only Hope (V) (Errata)]], 20 December 2021): Players Committee card image, 20 December 2021: 0 side [[:File:V14-L-ouronlyhope-20211220.png]] ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/6f54fd7f7220526489ac0bc6fe4a71a89ca75069/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/ouronlyhope.png Holotable commit 6f54fd7 “Set 17 images”], mark “E1”). Text: “Relocate Prophecy Of The Force to a site. OR If Like My Father Before Me on table, ▲ Yoda's Hut or a Death Star II site.” '''What changed:''' “If He Is The Chosen One or He Will Bring Balance on table” became “If Like My Father Before Me on table”; the copyright line “© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.” was added; the card prints the errata mark “E1”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Our Only Hope (V) (Errata 2)]], 31 May 2022): Players Committee card image, 31 May 2022: 0 side [[:File:V14-L-ouronlyhope.gif]] ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Light/hires/ouronlyhope.png Holotable commit 13a5f3a “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs”], mark “E1”). Text: “Relocate Prophecy Of The Force to a site. OR If Like My Father Before Me on table, ▲ Yoda's Hut or a Death Star II site.” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details; the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
